hypothesis.customerProblem: Small warehouse teams may lose track of shift inspection records and follow-up maintenance notes for powered trucks.
hypothesis.buyerTrigger: A supervisor prepares to hand over powered industrial truck activity at shift change.
hypothesis.expensiveFailure: An unresolved equipment observation may be missed when the next team searches for the relevant inspection record.
